definitions: A tooth of a saw: any of its series of projections, each with a cutting edge.
Something else that is shaped like such a tooth (for example, a roof or each peaked portion thereof; a curve or waveform on a graph).
Any of various pierid butterflies of the genus Prioneris.
A genre of Korean court music

blocks.text: Aak is a genre of Korean court music. It is an imported form of the Chinese court music yayue, and means "elegant music". Aak was performed almost exclusively in state sacrificial rites, and in the present day it is performed in certain Confucian ceremonies.

images.alt: Aak musicians at the Confucian ritual of Munmyo Shrine, Sungkyunkwan seowon
Bu and Pyeongyeong played in aak during Confucian ritual performance at Munmyo Shrine
